statement: ∀ (a q : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ q → (ENNReal.ofReal a) ^ q = ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ q)
proof:
intro a q ha hq
exact ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg ha hq
